failed (failure attribute and child) and skipped markers
'>' and '"' in the same name (r0-1 grammar)

test name ending ' time=' (time attribute hijacked: duration NaN, null once persisted)

failure= message suffix x status failed x id x duration (file/time must stay read from their own attributes, not from the failure= tail)
